tours.name: Review Which Companies a User Can Access

name_i18n.en_US: Review Which Companies a User Can Access

tours.description: Learn how to check the companies a user is allowed to work in and which one is their default.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to check the companies a user is allowed to work in and which one is their default.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.description: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

description_i18n.en_US: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

steps.title: Users & Companies
steps.description: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

description_i18n.en_US: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

steps.title: Users
steps.description: Every person who can sign in to Odoo is listed here. Open a user to see or change what that person is allowed to do.

description_i18n.en_US: Every person who can sign in to Odoo is listed here. Open a user to see or change what that person is allowed to do.

steps.title: Open a user
steps.content: Click a user to open the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a user to open the record.

steps.description: The Multi Companies section of the user shows which companies this person can work in.

description_i18n.en_US: The Multi Companies section of the user shows which companies this person can work in.

steps.title: Allowed Companies
steps.content: Click Allowed Companies to look at it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Allowed Companies to look at it.

steps.description: A user can only see data of the companies listed here. Records of other companies stay hidden from them. Add a company here to give the user access to it.

description_i18n.en_US: A user can only see data of the companies listed here. Records of other companies stay hidden from them. Add a company here to give the user access to it.

steps.title: Default Company
steps.content: Click Default Company to look at it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Default Company to look at it.

steps.description: The default company is the one selected when the user signs in. It must be one of the allowed companies.

description_i18n.en_US: The default company is the one selected when the user signs in. It must be one of the allowed companies.
